# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed 45  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v3 ch.People P3](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** alive (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Change P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.People P21](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0021)</sub>
- **Family:** [Irving](../character/irving.md) (spouse), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) (spouse), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a sweet and pretty lady with an almost girlish face featuring pink cheeks, dimples, sweet lips, and big, soft brown eyes. She has white, beautifully wavy and thick hair that is carefully styled in becoming puffs and coils, alongside pretty hands.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P25](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0025), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P34](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0034), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v3 ch.People P3](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0003)_

## Personality

Lavendar Lewis possesses a deeply imaginative nature. She relies heavily on making believe and pretending in order to cope with life.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)_

## Traits

- imaginative  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis lived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) alongside her young maid, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), where she eventually met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) when they stumbled upon her home and joined her for tea. Over subsequent visits, she shared the story of her past romance and quarrel with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and she soon formed a fond friendship with Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md). After experiencing a period of despondency, she received a note from [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) via [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading to his arrival at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and their reconciliation. The two were subsequently married in an intimate garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before departing. Later, during a summer vacation visit, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confided in Miss Lavendar that she had refused [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's marriage proposal because she viewed him only as a friend.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), +21 more_

## Background by volume

**Volume 2**

- formerly engaged to Stephen Irving when they were young  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036)</sub>
- hired little Charlotta Bowman for board and clothes after her mother died ten years earlier  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- presumed jilted by Stephen Irving according to local gossip  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- named Lavendar by her father because he loved the scent  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- suffered a broken heart when Stephen Irving did not return after their quarrel  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>

**Volume 3**

- lived at Echo Lodge before her marriage  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058)</sub>

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "to believe I’m old. Now, who are you . . . just for convenience’ sake? Diana Barry? And Anne Shirley? May I pretend that I’ve known you for a hundred years and call you Anne and Diana right away?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)

> "I love them myself. They are very good company . . . with a little pretending. On calm evenings Charlotta the Fourth and I often sit out here and amuse ourselves with them. Charlotta, take back the horn and hang it carefully in its place."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Lavendar Lewis are close friends who frequently visit one another. They met when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lost her way in the woods and stumbled upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where Lavendar invited her inside for tea. Over time, Lavendar confided in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her past romance, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helped facilitate her reunion and eventual wedding with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +14 more_

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) serves as the young helper and handmaiden to Miss Lavendar at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) assists her mistress around the house, helps prepare for guests, and demonstrates deep care for Lavendar's emotional well-being, such as expressing worry to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when Lavendar appears unusually despondent.

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--paul-irving.md)

[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) is Miss Lavendar's stepson, whom she affectionately bonded with over their shared imagination and love of dream-people. The two formed an immediate friendship when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) first introduced them, and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) eventually came to call her Mother Lavendar after her marriage to his father.
